## Logical Consistency Checks

### Check L1: Can skills be mandatory?

Deliverable: "There is no force-model-invocation or mandatory flag"
Reference: Frontmatter spec has no such field [DS-2 verified]
Community: Workaround exists using UserPromptSubmit hook [DS-15]

**Conclusion: CONSISTENT** -- Skills cannot be made mandatory through their
own mechanism. The workaround uses hooks (a different mechanism) to inject
skill evaluation instructions, confirming skills lack native mandatory
triggering.

### Check L2: Are hooks truly deterministic?

Deliverable: Hooks are deterministic
Counterpoint: Hooks have fail-open semantics for errors
Counterpoint: Hook scripts can be modified (CVE-2025-59536)

**Conclusion: CONSISTENT** -- The deliverable acknowledges both limitations
(fail-open in Section 10, hook modification in Section 8). "Deterministic"
refers to triggering (they always fire on matching events), not to immunity
from all attack vectors.

### Check L3: Is the convergence claim supported?

Deliverable: "Three of four major AI coding assistants have converged"
Evidence: Claude Code hooks [DS-1], Copilot hooks [DS-5/6], Cursor hooks [DS-7]
Counter: Windsurf lacks hooks [DS-9]

**Conclusion: CONSISTENT** -- 3/4 is accurately stated and supported.
